column7: During a Helm rolling update a replica from before AUDIT-VERIFY-STATE-1 re-signs the audit verification state row without its placement; the load no longer latches that as a sticky before-a-recorded-break discontinuity (audit verify, posture and the paging metric BROKEN with no clearing command). The in-chain marker names the generation that placed the state; a row re-signed after it, at the current checkpoint trail, below no recorded break and with no discontinuity event, is restarted (not_proven) and re-placed by the next full verification. A row from before the upgrade, a replayed one, one saved before a recorded break and a re-sign that dropped a discontinuity and an older replica's save after it rejected the row (deleted, put back, garbled), whatever generation that replica last read, still latch, as does a re-sign of a row that still carries a rejection (fail closed) (TestAuditVerifyStateRollingUpgrade_*Latches, TestAuditVerifyStateFailClosed_*).
